title: Budget the Retrieval
tagline: A cap counted in queries, where hitting it is a normal outcome rather than an error.

story.problem: An unbounded search loop is how a research specialist burns an afternoon and a budget without converging. Worse, a guard that demanded a fact no tool could reach turned the loop into a death spiral: one catering scout ran seven consecutive searches for a single drive time, spent its entire 25-search budget, and recorded one vendor. Nothing threw, and every surface that counted searches counted the calls it requested rather than the calls that happened, so a scout capped at 25 could report 30.
story.solution: A durable per-session counter in agent/lib/search-budget.ts — 25 for a specialist, 40 for the root, derived from ctx.session.parent rather than a tool argument. The unit is the query, not the tool call, so a four-query batch cannot quietly quadruple the budget. Calls that could never reach the provider return before the counter moves, and the batch is counted once so a retried transient failure is not charged twice. Exhaustion returns status cap_reached with an instruction to finish from what is already found, and the taxonomy in agent/lib/actions.ts classifies that as a refusal so toolRuns() reports searches performed rather than requested.
story.outcome: The guard was moved to a fact the tools can actually reach: the vendor's town stays required, the drive note is optional, and the scout is told never to search for one. Two npm run eval:scout runs over the same brief read 33/37 and 52/53 = 98%, with the radius judge at 100% in all five categories. scripts/test-trace-fold.mjs asserts that a search refused at the cap is not counted as a search, and scripts/test-outcomes.mjs fails if any tool status stops being classified.

prerequisites: An eve install with defineState and declared subagents (^0.24.4)
NEBIUS_API_KEY for a Token Factory model
TAVILY_API_KEY for live web search (the two checks in the recipe run without it)
The Delegation recipe's declared specialist — the cap is per agent because the session is per agent

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Nothing to configure for the two checks below. For the live agent, put NEBIUS_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY in .env.local (full list in README.md).
quickstart.run: npm run test:fold && npm run test:outcomes
